[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]HOW TO USE:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher(CP) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url] and Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url] [/font][/*]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#c9daf8][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#D4D4D8]If you already have another Cpntent Patcher[CP] sprite mod for these characters installed, this mod will not work. Only one CP sprite mod for the same characters can be loaded at a time.[/color][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=4][b]Notes:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#d4d4d8]This sprite redesign is based on my own interpretation of the characters and the original sprites. Because of this, there is no matching portrait mod, and I don't plan to make one in the future.😢 [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]♡Btw I recommend using it together with my [/color][b][color=#b4a7d6]Marriageable NPC Sprites[/color] [/b][color=#d4d4d8]mod: [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42028][color=#d4d4d8]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42028[/color][/url][/font]
